annotation.interpretation_b: The RRSet may contain multiple RRs, but only one is required to support the default transports; the others may not.
annotation.justification: The phrase "at least one RR" is incomplete. It does not specify whether *all* RRsets must have at least one RR supporting default transports, or whether only *some* RRsets need to satisfy this condition. This affects implementation because a DNS resolver must decide how to handle RRsets that do not meet this requirement.
